eyebrow: Two knobs control the whole rollout
code:
spec:
  replicas: 10
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 1   # never below 9 ready
      maxSurge: 1          # never above 11 total
caption: Up to 11 Pods total, never fewer than 9 ready — checkout stays reachable the whole time.

eyebrow: Checkout is 500ing after the deploy — now what
code:
kubectl rollout history deployment/checkout
kubectl rollout undo deployment/checkout
kubectl rollout undo deployment/checkout --to-revision=3
caption: Undo is itself a RollingUpdate in reverse — the rollback never causes a full outage either.

subtitle: What happens when identical, disposable Pods aren't enough.
